homepage.meta.title.message: Study and research notebook for your AI

homepage.meta.description.message: Tusab, a local connector (MCP) for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other AIs: your sources stay on your computer, and the AI gets only the right excerpts, citing the video and minute or the page.

homepage.hero.tagline.message: Your study and research notebook inside your AI.

homepage.hero.description.message: A local connector for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other AIs: it keeps YouTube videos, documents and public sources on your computer and gives the AI only the right excerpts, citing the video and minute or the page.

homepage.hero.otherAis.message: Use in ChatGPT, Gemini and others

homepage.hero.facts.message: Windows and macOS · no account, no login · your files stay on your computer

homepage.steps.1.text.message: YouTube channels and videos, PDFs, Word, spreadsheets, web pages and searches in public sources (papers, theses, laws, open data). All in a folder on your computer, organized by project.

homepage.steps.2.text.message: The AI searches your base and answers citing the source: the video and the exact minute, or the document and the page. It gets only the excerpts it looked up, not the whole base.

homepage.steps.3.text.message: Flashcards, quiz, summary, mind map, lesson plan. The AI builds them from your base, Tusab keeps them and schedules the spaced repetition. Everything stays in the Materials tab.

homepage.features.youtube.text.message: Whole channels, playlists or single videos. Subtitles are downloaded on your computer, with a queue, pause and automatic channel updates.

homepage.features.docs.text.message: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, Markdown and web pages. The AI cites the page and can open the original, images included, without location metadata.

homepage.features.public.text.message: Papers, theses, legislation, case law, open data and archives, from health to law, searched straight from the source and kept in the base.

homepage.features.prompts.text.message: Summaries, quizzes, flashcards, exams, lesson plans, source comparison and 20 evidence-based study techniques, each with its reference and the suggested AI model.

homepage.features.materials.text.message: What the AI produces is kept in Tusab and opens in a window: flashcards to flip, documents with tables and drawn diagrams. Exports to PDF.

homepage.features.screen.text.message: In the browser, on this computer only: extract, organize projects, see reports and copy requests. In Portuguese, English and Spanish, with light and dark themes.

homepage.privacy.1.message: Files, transcripts and the index stay in a folder on your computer.

homepage.privacy.2.message: The AI gets only the excerpts it looked up, and only the AI you chose.

homepage.privacy.3.message: Nothing goes through a CriAugu server: no account, login, telemetry or cloud sync.

homepage.privacy.4.message: The code is open to read on GitHub.

homepage.privacy.link.message: What leaves the computer, and where it goes

homepage.where.desktop.text.message: Open the .mcpb package and choose the base folder. Node.js already comes with Claude, and the ready-made requests show up in the + button.

homepage.where.chatgpt.text.message: The ChatGPT desktop app accepts Tusab through the same configuration as Codex, in Codex tasks. Needs Node.js installed.

homepage.where.others.title.message: Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, LM Studio

homepage.where.others.text.message: Any tool that accepts local MCP servers. With LM Studio, even the AI runs on your computer, offline.

homepage.where.web.badge.message: No install in the AI · copy and paste

homepage.where.web.text.message: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.ai and Copilot on the web cannot reach your computer. For them, Tusab copies the request with the excerpts from your base already inside.
